phase: Phase 1B — contract for the master 295 ledger. Additive; reuses the Phase 1A closed vocabularies.
ledger_invariants: Exactly 295 rows; metric_id set == frozen SW-001..295, each once (no duplicate, no gap).
Each row.module == the frozen Phase 0 module owner of its metric_id.
Each row.packet_id exists in packet-index.json and lists this metric_id; packet assignment is unique (one packet per ID).
Every Service-overlay id (18) has boundary_class=separate_serra_service AND disposition=outside_sales_domain AND source_existence_state=proved_outside_sales_domain AND evaluation_state=not_measured.

disposition == 'source_investigation_pending' => source_existence_state in ['unproved','investigation_pending'] AND evaluation_state == 'not_measured' AND owner/evidence_as_of/next_action/review_point present.

(disposition, source_existence_state) obeys frozen source_existence_state.disposition_consistency; (disposition, evaluation_state) obeys frozen disposition_evaluation_consistency; (source_existence_state, acquisition_admission_state) obeys the frozen allowed-pair matrix.
transitions are append-only and versioned: transitions[-1].to == row.disposition; each transition.to draws from the frozen disposition adjacency (or is the initial ledger-init entry with from=null).
measurable rows (disposition in ['measured_validated','data_acquired_calculation_pending']) have nonempty source_dependency_ids, each a registered source_id in the source registry.

A packet acceptance produces an acceptance hash over its accepted partitions + an independent receipt (packet artifact); the ledger row's report_acceptance_state advances only via a recorded transition.
